svg.text: Classic remains Tonos’s Material theme, refined selectively with useful Material 3 Expressive ideas.
LIGHT · warm near-white with clearer tonal steps
Only light-mode steps were separated slightly; the established dark palette is preserved.
Start/Finish use primary; success green is reserved for completed work.
Series and training intensity stay owned
Only general actions move to purple; semantic and data meanings do not.
System sans; larger type is reserved for page titles and focal metrics.
Settings row titles gain a little weight; supporting copy stays compact and muted.
Theme, onboarding, and bottom tab setup.
Current screens, order, controls, and five destinations
Dense workout logging and Progress data colors
Plan, completion, heatmap, and settings accents
Shape morphs, spring motion, and transitions
A single existing family, made clearer through theme roles and measured emphasis.
Interaction behavior is evaluated during Flutter / material_ui prototyping, not implied here.
